overview: From CA to luxury brand management, sports management to cooperatives — the broadest professional category in India. Includes both classical commerce paths (CA/CS/CMA/B.Com) and emerging niches (rural management, agribusiness, luxury brands, family business).
key_insights: IPM (5-year integrated MBA at IIMs) lets students bypass CAT entirely.
Rural Management at IRMA Anand has near-zero competition with placements averaging ₹15 LPA.
Actuarial Science (low-cost, high-pay, demand-exceeds-supply) is severely undersupplied in India.
Multiple high-paying niches (Luxury Brand, Agribusiness, Family Business) exist beyond conventional MBA.

sub_paths.name: BBA
sub_paths.description: General undergraduate business degree, foundation for management or MBA.
sub_paths.top_institutions: SSCBS (DU), Christ, NMIMS, Symbiosis Pune
sub_paths.scholarships: Central Sector Scheme, state minority/SC/ST, NMIMS/Christ institutional
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: UK / Australia 2-yr equivalents (₹25-50L)
sub_paths.day_in_life: General subjects in Year 1; specialise (finance/marketing/HR) later with live projects and internships.
sub_paths.growth_path: MBA, analyst roles, family business entry, parallel CA/CS/CMA
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: ₹3 – 6 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): ₹8 – 15 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): ₹18 – 35 LPA. Note: Wide variance by college tier; top privates hit ₹10+ LPA fresher..

sub_paths.name: IPM (5-yr Integrated MBA)
sub_paths.description: Direct-after-12th 5-year program ending in an MBA from an IIM. No CAT required.
sub_paths.top_institutions: IIM Indore, IIM Rohtak, IIM Jammu, IIM Bodh Gaya
sub_paths.scholarships: IIM need-based fee waiver (up to 100%), MCM, IIM corporate-funded
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: US/Canada 5-yr integrated (~₹80L+)
sub_paths.day_in_life: Years 1-3 undergrad management + liberal education; Years 4-5 full MBA.
sub_paths.growth_path: Direct IIM placement (~₹19-22 LPA avg). Bypass CAT entirely.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: ₹15 – 25 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): ₹25 – 45 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): ₹50 LPA – 1 Cr+. Note: IIM placement averages ₹19-22 LPA at IIM Indore IPM..

sub_paths.name: Chartered Accountancy (CA)
sub_paths.description: Premier finance and audit qualification. Professional certification, not a degree.
sub_paths.qualification: CA Foundation → Inter → Final + 2-yr articleship (ICAI New Scheme, eff. July 2023)
sub_paths.top_institutions: ICAI (single national body)
sub_paths.scholarships: ICAI merit-cum-means, JN Tata, state CA branch schemes
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MoUs with CPA-Canada, ICAEW-UK, CPA-Australia, SAICA-SA
sub_paths.day_in_life: Parallel to college or full-time. 3-year paid articleship at a CA firm. Audit, tax, consulting.
sub_paths.growth_path: Big-4 audit → industry CFO, own practice, IB/PE.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: ₹7 – 9 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): ₹15 – 30 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): ₹30 – 80 LPA+. Note: Rank-holders get ₹20+ LPA fresher at Big-4..

sub_paths.name: Company Secretary (CS)
sub_paths.description: Corporate law and governance specialist. Mandatory in companies with paid-up capital ≥₹5 crore.
sub_paths.top_institutions: ICSI (single national body)
sub_paths.scholarships: 50% fee concession SC/ST, merit at each level, EWS
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: ICSI MoU with Chartered Governance Institute UK
sub_paths.day_in_life: Can study alongside graduation. Roles: board meetings, ROC filings, SEBI compliance.
sub_paths.growth_path: In-house CS → compliance officer → governance head.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: ₹4 – 7 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): ₹8 – 18 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): ₹15 – 35 LPA. Note: Independent practice can scale beyond salaried bands..

sub_paths.name: Cost & Management Accountancy (CMA)
sub_paths.description: Costing, budgeting, strategic management accounting. Mandatory in many manufacturing and PSU contexts.
sub_paths.top_institutions: ICMAI (Institute of Cost Accountants)
sub_paths.scholarships: ICMAI scholarships, SC/ST concessions, EWS
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: CIMA-UK, US CMA via IMA — partial exemptions both ways
sub_paths.day_in_life: Costing departments, internal audit, financial planning, PSUs (BHEL, NTPC).
sub_paths.growth_path: Cost auditor → mgmt accountant → CFO track in manufacturing.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: ₹5 – 8 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): ₹10 – 20 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): ₹20 – 50 LPA. Note: Manufacturing/PSU bias keeps demand stable..

sub_paths.name: B.Com / B.Com (Hons)
sub_paths.description: Most versatile undergrad commerce degree. Feeder to CA, CS, CMA, MBA, banking, civil services.
sub_paths.entrance_exam: CUET UG, IPU CET, state CETs
sub_paths.top_institutions: SRCC, LSR, Hindu (DU), Christ, Loyola, Stella Maris
sub_paths.scholarships: Central Sector Scheme, DU scholarships, PM-USP, state OBC/SC/ST
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: BSc Accounting & Finance UK, BCom Australia/Canada — ₹15-40L
sub_paths.day_in_life: Theory (accounting, law, economics) + practical (Tally, GST, Excel).
sub_paths.growth_path: CA/CS/CMA in parallel, MBA, banking exams, SSC, UPSC.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: ₹3 – 6 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): ₹6 – 12 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): ₹12 – 25 LPA. Note: Depends heavily on what follows (CA, MBA, bank PO)..

sub_paths.name: Integrated BBA-MBA (Private)
sub_paths.description: Private university version of integrated MBA. Wider availability, variable quality.
sub_paths.top_institutions: NMIMS, Symbiosis, Amity, Manipal, UPES
sub_paths.scholarships: Institutional merit (up to 100% at some), need-based concessions
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Similar US/UK programs (much costlier)
sub_paths.day_in_life: Similar to IPM but with institutional variation.
sub_paths.growth_path: Top privates ₹10-15 LPA avg; lower privates ₹4-6 LPA.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: ₹4 – 12 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): ₹10 – 22 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): ₹20 – 50 LPA. Note: Wide range depending on institute tier..

sub_paths.name: Rural Management
sub_paths.description: Manage cooperatives, agribusinesses, NGOs, rural-focused companies. Almost no competition.
sub_paths.top_institutions: IRMA Anand, XIM Bhubaneswar, KIIT, TISS Tuljapur
sub_paths.scholarships: IDFC First Bank MBA, Mirae Asset Foundation, IRMA merit + need
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: SOAS London, Wageningen NL
sub_paths.day_in_life: Village fieldwork part of curriculum. Placements: Amul, ITC-Agri, Tata Trusts, NABARD.
sub_paths.growth_path: IRMA 2024: avg ₹15 LPA, highest ₹31 LPA.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: ₹10 – 18 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): ₹18 – 35 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): ₹35 – 70 LPA. Note: IRMA 2024 median ₹15 LPA, highest ₹31.16 LPA..

sub_paths.name: Sports Management
sub_paths.description: Manage teams, leagues, athletes, sports brands, events. Growing fast with IPL, ISL.
sub_paths.qualification: BSM (3 yr) / MSM (2 yr) / PGP (11 mo)
sub_paths.top_institutions: IISM Mumbai, Symbiosis Pune, NSU Chennai
sub_paths.scholarships: IISM merit (sports + academic), state sports dept scholarships
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Ohio State, Loughborough UK, FIFA Master — ₹25L-1Cr
sub_paths.day_in_life: Live events, team operations, athlete management, marketing.
sub_paths.growth_path: Recruiters: BCCI, SAI, Star Sports, Dream11, Decathlon.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: ₹3 – 5 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): ₹6 – 12 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): ₹15 – 30 LPA+. Note: IISM 2025: highest ₹12 LPA, avg ₹3-5 LPA..

sub_paths.name: Family Business Management
sub_paths.description: For students from business families. Covers succession, governance, expansion.
sub_paths.top_institutions: NMIMS, Symbiosis, SPJIMR, EDII Ahmedabad
sub_paths.scholarships: Institutional need-based, Jamnalal Bajaj scholarships
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: IMD Lausanne, Kellogg, HEC Paris
sub_paths.day_in_life: Curriculum on succession, governance, scaling. Live project on own family business.
sub_paths.growth_path: Returns to family business directly; some start new ventures.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: Variable / Mid (4-7 yr): Variable / Senior (10+ yr): Variable. Note: Tied to family enterprise performance, not a salary-sector..

sub_paths.name: Luxury Brand Management
sub_paths.description: Manage premium/luxury brands — fashion, hotels, automobiles, jewellery, spirits.
sub_paths.qualification: PG Diploma / MBA Luxury Brand Management
sub_paths.top_institutions: Pearl Academy, MBA ESG, SPJIMR, IIM Udaipur
sub_paths.scholarships: Institutional merit, industry-tied partial funding
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: SDA Bocconi, ESSEC Paris, HEC, NYU Stern, LBS — ₹40L-1Cr+
sub_paths.day_in_life: Fashion houses, luxury hotels, jewellery brands. Brand building, CRM, retail strategy.
sub_paths.growth_path: Top recruiters: LVMH, Tata Luxury, Taj, Forevermark.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: ₹6 – 10 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): ₹12 – 25 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): ₹25 – 60 LPA. Note: Indian luxury market growing 10%+ annually..

sub_paths.name: Hotel & Hospitality Management
sub_paths.description: Not just hotels — cruise lines, airlines, hospitals, corporate catering, resort chains.
sub_paths.top_institutions: IHM Pusa, Mumbai, Bangalore, Chennai
sub_paths.scholarships: IHM merit, industry-tied (Taj, Oberoi), central schemes
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Les Roches, Glion, Cornell, EHL — ₹40L-1.5Cr
sub_paths.day_in_life: Kitchen, front office, housekeeping, F&B rotations early.
sub_paths.growth_path: GM-level ₹30L-1Cr+. Cruise/Middle East roles 2-3x India.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: ₹2.5 – 4.5 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): ₹7 – 15 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): ₹20 – 60 LPA+. Note: GM-level at top hotel groups can exceed ₹1Cr..

sub_paths.name: Event Management
sub_paths.description: Plan and execute corporate events, weddings, concerts, sports events, exhibitions.
sub_paths.qualification: Cert / Diploma / BBA / PGDM Event Mgmt
sub_paths.top_institutions: NIEM, EMDI, IIEM, Whistling Woods, Amity
sub_paths.scholarships: Institutional only; industry-tied internships reduce effective cost
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Edinburgh Napier, UNLV — ₹20-40L
sub_paths.day_in_life: Office planning + on-ground execution. Long hours on event days.
sub_paths.growth_path: Successful independent entrepreneurs scale beyond salaried bands.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: ₹2 – 4 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): ₹6 – 15 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): ₹15 – 40 LPA. Note: Heavy freelance/entrepreneur skew..

sub_paths.name: Supply Chain & Logistics
sub_paths.description: Manage movement of goods. Exploded post-pandemic with e-commerce boom.
sub_paths.top_institutions: IIFT Delhi/Kolkata, IIM Kashipur, NITIE Mumbai
sub_paths.scholarships: IIFT, NITIE institutional; MoL&J for SC/ST
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MIT Supply Chain, Arizona State, Cranfield — ₹30L-1Cr
sub_paths.day_in_life: Planning, procurement, warehousing, distribution. Increasingly tech-driven.
sub_paths.growth_path: Recruiters: Amazon, Flipkart, DHL, Maersk, Blue Dart.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: ₹4 – 8 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): ₹12 – 25 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): ₹25 – 60 LPA. Note: E-commerce boom inflated demand significantly..

sub_paths.name: Healthcare / Hospital Management
sub_paths.description: Administrative leadership of hospitals, clinics, insurance, pharma. MBA-led, not MBBS.
sub_paths.top_institutions: AIIMS Delhi, TISS Mumbai, IIHMR Jaipur
sub_paths.scholarships: AIIMS/TISS merit, institute-specific need-based
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Johns Hopkins, LSE Health Policy, Harvard T.H. Chan — ₹40L-1Cr
sub_paths.day_in_life: Run hospital/clinic/insurer ops: admin, finance, quality, patient experience.
sub_paths.growth_path: Recruiters: Apollo, Fortis, Max, Medanta, UnitedHealth.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: ₹5 – 9 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): ₹12 – 25 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): ₹30 – 80 LPA+. Note: Apollo/Fortis COOs ₹1Cr+..

sub_paths.name: Agribusiness Management
sub_paths.description: Manage agri-input companies, food processing, contract farming, farmer producer orgs.
sub_paths.top_institutions: IIM Ahmedabad FABM, MANAGE Hyderabad, NIAM Jaipur
sub_paths.scholarships: ICAR fellowships, MANAGE need-based, IIM-A waivers
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Wageningen NL, Cornell AEM, Purdue — ₹30-70L
sub_paths.day_in_life: Commodity trading, farm-to-fork supply chain, food processing, agri-fintech.
sub_paths.growth_path: Recruiters: ITC Agri, Mahindra, UPL, Olam, Cargill.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: ₹5 – 10 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): ₹12 – 25 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): ₹25 – 60 LPA. Note: IIM-A FABM grads avg ₹25 LPA; agri-uni route ₹5-8 LPA start..

sub_paths.name: Actuarial Science
sub_paths.description: Risk and mathematical modelling for insurance, pensions, finance. One of the highest-paid globally.
sub_paths.qualification: IAI Fellowship (13 papers) / UK IFoA / US SOA
sub_paths.top_institutions: Institute of Actuaries of India (IAI Mumbai)
sub_paths.scholarships: IAI partial fee waivers, sponsorship by insurance companies
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: UK IFoA, US SOA portable globally
sub_paths.day_in_life: Modelling insurance products, pricing risk, reserving, regulatory filings.
sub_paths.growth_path: Demand exceeds supply globally.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: ₹6 – 10 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): ₹15 – 35 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): ₹35 – 80 LPA+. Note: Full Fellowship commands premium. Globally portable..

sub_paths.name: Entrepreneurship
sub_paths.description: Learn to build businesses. Degree paths exist alongside incubators and accelerators.
sub_paths.top_institutions: EDII Ahmedabad, SPJIMR, IIM-B NSRCEL, ISB
sub_paths.scholarships: Wadhwani Foundation, Atal Innovation Mission, govt incubator stipends
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Babson College USA, Stanford, IE Madrid — ₹60L-1.2Cr
sub_paths.day_in_life: Build something. Many programs require you to start a business.
sub_paths.growth_path: Non-linear — own business or join startups.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: Variable / Mid (4-7 yr): Variable / Senior (10+ yr): Variable. Note: Founder salaries low early; upside in equity..

sub_paths.name: Banking & Financial Services
sub_paths.description: Direct specialist track via professional certifications. Combined with govt bank exams for PSU entry.
sub_paths.top_institutions: NIBM Pune, IIBF Mumbai, MDI Gurgaon, NMIMS
sub_paths.scholarships: NIBM merit, IIBF for SC/ST
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: CFA USA, ACCA UK — portable globally
sub_paths.day_in_life: Relationship banking, credit analysis, operations, treasury, risk.
sub_paths.growth_path: PSU bank PO ₹7-9 LPA + benefits; private start ₹4-10 LPA.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: ₹4 – 9 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): ₹10 – 25 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): ₹25 – 70 LPA. Note: Senior private bank roles ₹40L-3Cr..

sub_paths.name: Public Policy / Development Mgmt
sub_paths.description: Analyse and shape policy for govt, think tanks, foundations, international orgs.
sub_paths.qualification: MA/MPP Public Policy / PGD Public Policy
sub_paths.top_institutions: TISS Mumbai, IIM Bangalore PPM, Ashoka, NLSIU
sub_paths.scholarships: TISS need-based, Ashoka young-India scholars, Azim Premji
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Harvard Kennedy, Oxford MPP, LKY Singapore — ₹40L-1Cr
sub_paths.day_in_life: Research, policy briefs, fieldwork, stakeholder consultations.
sub_paths.growth_path: Growing demand from Niti Aayog, state govts, foundations.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: ₹4 – 8 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): ₹12 – 25 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): ₹25 – 60 LPA. Note: IIM-B PPM placements higher; NGO/govt roles modest..

sub_paths.name: Digital Marketing (skill-first)
sub_paths.description: No-degree-needed entry into marketing via certifications and portfolio. Highly accessible.
sub_paths.top_institutions: Google Digital Garage, NSDC, DigitalVidya, UpGrad
sub_paths.scholarships: NSDC-linked (PMKVY), Google Career Certificates need-based waivers
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Globally recognised; remote work common
sub_paths.day_in_life: Running ads, copy, SEO, analytics, social, email.
sub_paths.growth_path: Freelancers can match or beat salaried peers.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: ₹2.5 – 5 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): ₹6 – 15 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): ₹15 – 40 LPA+. Note: Strong remote-work options globally..

sub_paths.name: Cooperative Management
sub_paths.description: Manage cooperatives — Amul, IFFCO, co-op banks. Massive sector, undersupplied professionally.
sub_paths.top_institutions: VAMNICOM Pune; related: IRMA, NIAM, NCDC
sub_paths.scholarships: NCDC, need-based at VAMNICOM, SC/ST
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Niche abroad
sub_paths.day_in_life: PACS, DCCBs, dairy unions, producer companies. Policy + ops.
sub_paths.growth_path: NABARD, NDDB, co-op banks.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: ₹5 – 8 LPA / Mid (4-7 yr): ₹10 – 20 LPA / Senior (10+ yr): ₹18 – 40 LPA. Note: Stable, co-op/NABARD-adjacent roles dominate..

data_confidence_notes: BM domain originally researched by Career Roads team for v1; salary data verified against AmbitionBox, Glassdoor India, IIM placement reports.
Family Business Management and Cooperative Management have inherently variable compensation tied to enterprise performance, not salaried norms.
